sources.snippet: This model with modified ecapa based encoder [1] is trained end-to-end using angular softmax loss for speaker verification and diarization purposes and for extracting speaker embeddings Model Architecture ECAPA models consists of blocks of time delay neural blocks (TDNNs) and squeeze and excite (SE) layers unified with blocks of Res2Block layers.
